title: Competency-based Remuneration at Public Healthcare Institutions
what_it_is: Competency-based Remuneration at Public Healthcare Institutions

sections.label: Healthcare hiring beyond academics
sections.summary: Public healthcare institutions are progressively moving beyond academic qualifications to skills and competencies in recruitment, remuneration and promotion of staff.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Public healthcare institutions are progressively moving beyond academic qualifications to skills and competencies in the recruitment, remuneration and promotion of staff.

sections.label: Competency-based healthcare HR system
sections.summary: Beyond entry grade, salary and progression are performance- and competency-based, and MOH partners SkillsFuture Singapore to develop Skills Frameworks for healthcare workforce.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Beyond the entry grade, salary and career progression are now mostly performance- and competency-based.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For example, nurses' remuneration and promotion depend primarily on their job performance and acquisition of specialised skills, rather than their previous academic attainment or grades.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To further strengthen the competency-based human resource system, the Ministry of Health is partnering SkillsFuture Singapore to develop the Skills Frameworks for Healthcare for the healthcare workforce, including nurses, allied health professionals, pharmacy technicians and support care staff.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Skills Framework will articulate the roles, skills, competencies and training required for each job role.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We also hope to work with the unions to implement the Skills Framework when it is ready by the end of this year.
